headline: This cannot be done as you asked, so no workflow is offered for it.
points: "please use a learning rate of 0.001, 500 iterations and a stronger weight on the PPI term" -- not available here as asked. NetZoo runs GIRAFFE with its package defaults and passes no settings to it, so "learning rate of 0.001" cannot be applied. GIRAFFE itself can still run, with its own settings…
